verified_contracts: A = 0.5 normalized action L1 to frozen full teacher + 0.5 L1 to normalized executed demonstration; B adds 0.1 future target MSE.
Single full512 score; per-camera differentiable soft mass64; same shared hard function selects sorted original128 indices with64 per camera.
Action loss and future MSE independently produce nonzero DIE gradients. Future head gradients are nonzero. Frozen VLA/projector/head parameter bytes are unchanged after optimizer steps.
A/B cloned scorer initialization produces identical scores, gates and action outputs before training. Future/GT mutations do not enter the DIE input.
Future target uses detached future projected features, camera2x2 pooling, private CPU Gaussian seed917/sqrt(D) projection64 per cell, per-cell LayerNorm eps1e-5, FP32 target512.
Future head receives only gated current projected bins512 and executed normalized demonstration8x7; no ungated vision, language or proprio bypass.
Runner acceptance and validation APIs execute against real shared classes on CPU toy tensors; report writes were intercepted in memory and no real-model F01 gate was produced.

Actual tiny A/B train_pair serialization: interruption after persisted update0, resume, two updates per arm, evaluations exactly[0,2], equal initial scorer and sample-order hashes, frozen-base check passes.

remaining_limitations.detail: No real BF16 VLA forward/backward, CUDA memory/OOM, dataset-window producer or real rollout/latency result is established by these CPU tests. F01 must verify these separately.

validate_hard currently has no durable per-forward start/complete journal. Hard interruption during a60-window validation leaves unknown partial policy-forward cost, not zero. Training update_start/end records update attempts but final arm wall_seconds_this_attempt excludes earlier attempts; aggregate actual server/job receipts before total-cost claims.

Resume checkpoints preserve scorer/head/optimizer/validation state and fixed deterministic sample schedule, but do not serialize global RNG states. Current shared modules have no stochastic forward/dropout; future stochastic changes require explicit RNG persistence and equivalence tests.
This is CTI-DIE matched ACL adaptation, not native ACL reproduction. CPU correctness does not establish learned benefit or scientific go.
